arxiv-2111-11235.title: Quasitriangular Hopf algebras of dimension p ​ q 2 pq^{2} Thanks: † Supported by NSFC 11722016.
arxiv-2111-11235.creator: Kun Zhou and Gongxiang Liu
arxiv-2111-11235.description: Abstract . Let p p and q q be distinct odd primes and assume 𝕜 \Bbbk is an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero. We classify all quasitriangular Hopf algebras of dimension p ​ q 2 pq^{2} over 𝕜 \Bbbk , which are not simple as Hopf algebras. Moreover, we obtained all quasitriangular structures on these Hopf algebras.

arxiv-2207-08518.title: HiFormer: Hierarchical Multi-scale Representations Using Transformers for Medical Image Segmentation
arxiv-2207-08518.creator: Moein Heidari, Amirhossein Kazerouni, Milad Soltany, Reza Azad, Ehsan Khodapanah Aghdam, Julien Cohen-Adad, Dorit Merhof
arxiv-2207-08518.description: Abstract Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have been the consensus for medical image segmentation tasks. However, they suffer from the limitation in modeling long-range dependencies and spatial correlations due to the nature of convolution operation. Although transformers were first developed to address this issue, they fail to capture low-level features.

arxiv-2211-07161.title: Is FIDO2 Passwordless Authentication a Hype or for Real?: A Position Paper Thanks: This research is funded by TUBITAK (The Scientific and Technological Research Council of Turkey) under the grants No: 3211046 and No:3200184.
arxiv-2211-07161.creator: Kemal Bicakci, Yusuf Uzunay
arxiv-2211-07161.description: Abstract Operating system and browser support that comes with the FIDO2 standard and the biometric user verification options increasingly available on smart phones has excited everyone, especially big tech companies, about the passwordless future. Does a dream come true, are we finally totally getting rid of passwords?

arxiv-2308-03984.title: Global Diffusive expansion of Boltzmann Equation in exterior Domain Thanks: Submitted to the editors DATE.
arxiv-2308-03984.creator: Junhwa Jung
arxiv-2308-03984.description: Abstract The study of flows over an obstacle is one of the fundamental problems in fluids. In this paper we establish the global validity of the diffusive expansion for the Boltzmann equations to the Navier-Stokes-Fourier system in an exterior domain.

arxiv-2404-05879.title: Rapid and Precise Topological Comparison with Merge Tree Neural Networks
arxiv-2404-05879.creator: Yu Qin, Brittany Terese Fasy, Carola Wenk, and Brian Summa
arxiv-2404-05879.description: Abstract Merge trees are a valuable tool in the scientific visualization of scalar fields; however, current methods for merge tree comparisons are computationally expensive, primarily due to the exhaustive matching between tree nodes. To address this challenge, we introduce the Merge Tree Neural Network (MTNN), a learned neural network model designed for merge tree comparison.

pmc-10681950.title: Polydopamine-activated celastrol carbon dots for synergistic chemotherapy-photothermal therapy of tumors
pmc-10681950.creator: Ping Sheng, Chao Bu, Tanyue Hui, Lili Zhou, Hao Chen, Guoliang Zhou
pmc-10681950.description: Synergistic chemotherapy and photothermal therapy (PTT) holds the promise of addressing the weakness of individualized chemotherapy and PTT. In this study, we synthesized a chemotherapeutic agent, PDA-Ce-CDs, which combines the photothermal conversion ability and the generation of hydroxyl radicals (•OH), enabling synergistic enhancement of antitumor effects.

pmc-10744730.title: Survey of Transfer Learning Approaches in the Machine Learning of Digital Health Sensing Data
pmc-10744730.creator: Lina Chato, Emma Regentova, Pascale Gauthier
pmc-10744730.description: Machine learning and digital health sensing data have led to numerous research achievements aimed at improving digital health technology. However, using machine learning in digital health poses challenges related to data availability, such as incomplete, unstructured, and fragmented data, as well as issues related to data privacy, security, and data format standardization.

pmc-11545451.title: Evaluation of Selected MRI Parameters in the Differentiation of Mucinous Ovarian Carcinomas and Metastatic Ovarian Tumors
pmc-11545451.creator: Marta Halaburda-Rola, Laretta Grabowska-Derlatka, Leszek Kraj, Rafal Stec, Pawel Derlatka, Ming Yin Lin, Emma R Allanson
pmc-11545451.description: Simple SummaryInitial evaluation of ovarian lesions is essential in proper preoperative assessment. Correct preoperative differentiation between mucinous ovarian carcinomas and metastatic ovarian tumors enables precise treatment planning and the individualization of therapy. The correlation of selected MRI parameters enables precise differential diagnosis.Keywords: MRI, mucinous ovarian carcinoma, metastatic ovarian tumor 1.

pmc-11646055.title: P063 App-delivered Sleep Therapy for Older Individuals with insomnia (ASTEROID Study) – mixed method user experience study
pmc-11646055.creator: M Rahimi, C Hoyos, J Chapman, J Cheung, S Lee, D Bartlett, S Lillis, R Grunstein, C Gordon
pmc-11646055.description: IntroductionInsomnia affects over 40% of older adults, impacting on their health and quality of life, but is often untreated. This study investigated the acceptability of digital therapy for insomnia in older adults using a mixed-methods approach.MethodEligible (age≥60, ISI≥10) respondents participated in an online survey exploring their smartphone usage patterns, app design preferences, and experiences with health and sleep-related apps.

pmc-13142038.title: Role of STAT1 in modulating the host immune response to Plasmodium yoelii 17XL-infected murine blood-stage malaria
pmc-13142038.creator: Yifan Sun, Chenyan Du, Qinwen Xu, Zhe Chen, Xin Feng, Su Han, Yan Yan, Bo Wang, Zhiyue Lv, Guoding Zhu, Jianping Cao, Yang Cheng
pmc-13142038.description: The spleen is critically involved in the immune response to malaria parasite infections. However, the precise molecular mechanisms underlying splenic immune regulation and anemia during malaria remain elusive. This study aimed to identify the key regulatory proteins in Plasmodium yoelii (Py)-infected host spleen and investigate its role in malaria pathogenesis.

pmc-13295642.title: Self-Induced Anaerobic Fermented Products of Bacillus subtilis M6 and Lactiplantibacillus plantarum R101 Improve Growth Performance in Broilers
pmc-13295642.creator: Yi-Tai Hsu, Kuo-Lung Chen, Ching-Chi Hung
pmc-13295642.description: Simple SummaryTwo-stage fermented products have been shown to improve broiler growth performance; however, their production processes are time-consuming and require substantial equipment and energy inputs, thereby increasing production costs. This study evaluated a one-stage self-induced anaerobic fermented product (SIAFP) characterized by a shorter processing time and lower equipment requirements.

pmc-13314949.title: Industrial robots and worker health in China: evidence on sectoral heterogeneity and institutional moderation
pmc-13314949.creator: Wubin Yuan, Yuan Wang
pmc-13314949.description: Against the backdrop of a rising organic composition of capital driven by industrial automation, this paper examines how industrial robot adoption is associated with worker health in China and how these effects vary across groups, with particular attention to the role of labor-market institutions.

pmc-13564966.title: Recurrent Unilateral Vulvar Syringoma Mimicking Treatment-Resistant Condyloma Acuminata: A Case Report and Review of the Literature
pmc-13564966.creator: Saeed Baradwan, Mohammad Alyafi, Haneen Al-Maghrabi, Sumaih Shinawi
pmc-13564966.description: Background: Vulvar syringoma is a rare benign adnexal neoplasm originating from eccrine sweat ducts. Although syringomas most commonly occur in the periorbital region, vulvar involvement is uncommon and frequently underrecognized. Due to its nonspecific clinical appearance, vulvar syringoma may mimic more common vulvar conditions, resulting in delayed diagnosis and repeated ineffective treatments.
